stages.name: assignments

stages.name: declarations
stages.query: SELECT "__path","__start","__end","id","parent",NULL AS "edge_parent","kind",NULL AS "line","text",NULL AS "ordinal",NULL AS "parent_start",NULL AS "parent_end",NULL AS "parent_kind",NULL AS "ancestor_start",NULL AS "ancestor_end",NULL AS "ancestor_kind",NULL AS "name_id",NULL AS "name_start",NULL AS "name_end",NULL AS "name_kind",NULL AS "name_source",NULL AS "left_id",NULL AS "left_start",NULL AS "left_end",NULL AS "left_kind",NULL AS "right_id",NULL AS "right_start",NULL AS "right_end",NULL AS "right_kind",NULL AS "value_id",NULL AS "value_start",NULL AS "value_end",NULL AS "value_kind",NULL AS "function_id",NULL AS "function_start",NULL AS "function_end",NULL AS "function_kind",NULL AS "arguments_id",NULL AS "arguments_start",NULL AS "arguments_end",NULL AS "arguments_kind",NULL AS "object_id",NULL AS "object_start",NULL AS "object_end",NULL AS "object_kind",NULL AS "object_source",NULL AS "attribute_id",NULL AS "attribute_source","body_id","body_start",NULL AS "body_end",NULL AS "body_kind",NULL AS "alias_id",NULL AS "alias_source",NULL AS "module_name_id",NULL AS "module_name_start",NULL AS "module_name_end",NULL AS "module_name_kind",NULL AS "module_name_source","name","region_start" FROM (SELECT n.*,n.name_source name,coalesce(w.__start,n.__start) region_start FROM nodes n LEFT JOIN nodes w ON w.__path=n.__path AND w.id=n.parent AND w.kind='decorated_definition' WHERE n.kind IN ('function_definition','class_definition'))

stages.name: declaration_links
stages.query: SELECT "__path","id","lexical_parent" FROM (WITH RECURSIVE parent(__path,root,node) AS (SELECT __path,id,parent FROM declarations UNION ALL SELECT p.__path,p.root,n.parent FROM parent p JOIN nodes n ON n.__path=p.__path AND n.id=p.node WHERE n.kind NOT IN ('function_definition','class_definition')) SELECT p.__path,p.root id,d.id lexical_parent FROM parent p JOIN declarations d ON d.__path=p.__path AND d.id=p.node)

stages.name: declaration_contexts
stages.query: SELECT "__path","__start","__end","id","parent",NULL AS "edge_parent","kind",NULL AS "line","text",NULL AS "ordinal",NULL AS "parent_start",NULL AS "parent_end",NULL AS "parent_kind",NULL AS "ancestor_start",NULL AS "ancestor_end",NULL AS "ancestor_kind",NULL AS "name_id",NULL AS "name_start",NULL AS "name_end",NULL AS "name_kind",NULL AS "name_source",NULL AS "left_id",NULL AS "left_start",NULL AS "left_end",NULL AS "left_kind",NULL AS "right_id",NULL AS "right_start",NULL AS "right_end",NULL AS "right_kind",NULL AS "value_id",NULL AS "value_start",NULL AS "value_end",NULL AS "value_kind",NULL AS "function_id",NULL AS "function_start",NULL AS "function_end",NULL AS "function_kind",NULL AS "arguments_id",NULL AS "arguments_start",NULL AS "arguments_end",NULL AS "arguments_kind",NULL AS "object_id",NULL AS "object_start",NULL AS "object_end",NULL AS "object_kind",NULL AS "object_source",NULL AS "attribute_id",NULL AS "attribute_source","body_id","body_start",NULL AS "body_end",NULL AS "body_kind",NULL AS "alias_id",NULL AS "alias_source",NULL AS "module_name_id",NULL AS "module_name_start",NULL AS "module_name_end",NULL AS "module_name_kind",NULL AS "module_name_source","name","region_start","qualname","lexical_parent" FROM (WITH RECURSIVE qualified(__path,id,qualname,lexical_parent) AS (SELECT d.__path,d.id,d.name,NULL FROM declarations d WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM declaration_links link WHERE link.__path=d.__path AND link.id=d.id) UNION ALL SELECT d.__path,d.id,q.qualname||'.'||d.name,q.id FROM qualified q JOIN declaration_links link ON link.__path=q.__path AND link.lexical_parent=q.id JOIN declarations d ON d.__path=link.__path AND d.id=link.id) SELECT d.*,q.qualname,q.lexical_parent FROM declarations d JOIN qualified q ON q.__path=d.__path AND q.id=d.id)

stages.name: decorator_names
stages.query:
SELECT "__path","fn",NULL AS "decorator","node","name" FROM (WITH RECURSIVE walk(__path,fn,decorator,node) AS (
        SELECT f.__path,f.id,d.id,x.id FROM declarations f JOIN nodes wrapper ON wrapper.__path=f.__path AND wrapper.id=f.parent AND wrapper.kind='decorated_definition' JOIN nodes d ON d.__path=wrapper.__path AND d.parent=wrapper.id AND d.kind='decorator' JOIN nodes x ON x.__path=d.__path AND x.parent=d.id
        UNION ALL SELECT w.__path,w.fn,w.decorator,c.callee_id FROM walk w JOIN calls c ON c.__path=w.__path AND c.id=w.node)
        SELECT w.__path,w.fn,w.decorator,w.node,coalesce(a.attr,n.text) name FROM walk w JOIN nodes n ON n.__path=w.__path AND n.id=w.node LEFT JOIN attributes a ON a.__path=n.__path AND a.id=n.id WHERE n.kind IN ('identifier','attribute'))

stages.name: expression_roots
stages.query: SELECT "__path","expression",NULL AS "id","name",NULL AS "through_call" FROM (WITH RECURSIVE root(__path,expression,node,through_call) AS (SELECT __path,id,id,0 FROM nodes UNION ALL SELECT r.__path,r.expression,c.id,r.through_call OR n.kind='call' FROM root r JOIN nodes n ON n.__path=r.__path AND n.id=r.node JOIN nodes c ON c.__path=n.__path AND c.id=CASE WHEN n.kind='attribute' THEN n.object_id WHEN n.kind='subscript' THEN n.value_id WHEN n.kind='call' THEN n.function_id WHEN n.kind IN ('parenthesized_expression','type') THEN (SELECT child.id FROM nodes child WHERE child.__path=n.__path AND child.parent=n.id AND child.ordinal=0 LIMIT 1) END) SELECT r.__path,r.expression,n.id,n.text name,r.through_call FROM root r JOIN nodes n ON n.__path=r.__path AND n.id=r.node WHERE n.kind='identifier')

stages.name: imports
stages.query: SELECT "__path","id","__start","__end","module","local","name","kind","fn" FROM (SELECT n.__path,n.id,n.__start,n.__end,n.module_name_source module,coalesce(x.alias_source,x.name_source,x.text) local,coalesce(x.name_source,x.text) name,n.kind,owner.fn FROM nodes n JOIN nodes x ON x.__path=n.__path AND x.parent=n.id AND x.kind IN ('dotted_name','aliased_import') AND x.id IS NOT n.module_name_id JOIN ownership owner ON owner.__path=n.__path AND owner.id=n.id WHERE n.kind IN ('import_statement','import_from_statement'))

stages.name: analyzer_functions
stages.query:
SELECT "__path","__start","__end","id",NULL AS "parent",NULL AS "edge_parent",NULL AS "kind",NULL AS "line","text",NULL AS "ordinal",NULL AS "parent_start",NULL AS "parent_end",NULL AS "parent_kind",NULL AS "ancestor_start",NULL AS "ancestor_end",NULL AS "ancestor_kind",NULL AS "name_id",NULL AS "name_start",NULL AS "name_end",NULL AS "name_kind",NULL AS "name_source",NULL AS "left_id",NULL AS "left_start",NULL AS "left_end",NULL AS "left_kind",NULL AS "right_id",NULL AS "right_start",NULL AS "right_end",NULL AS "right_kind",NULL AS "value_id",NULL AS "value_start",NULL AS "value_end",NULL AS "value_kind",NULL AS "function_id",NULL AS "function_start",NULL AS "function_end",NULL AS "function_kind",NULL AS "arguments_id",NULL AS "arguments_start",NULL AS "arguments_end",NULL AS "arguments_kind",NULL AS "object_id",NULL AS "object_start",NULL AS "object_end",NULL AS "object_kind",NULL AS "object_source",NULL AS "attribute_id",NULL AS "attribute_source","body_id","body_start",NULL AS "body_end",NULL AS "body_kind",NULL AS "alias_id",NULL AS "alias_source",NULL AS "module_name_id",NULL AS "module_name_start",NULL AS "module_name_end",NULL AS "module_name_kind",NULL AS "module_name_source","name",NULL AS "region_start","qualname","lexical_parent","symbol","sensitive","bootstrap","reconciliation" FROM (SELECT f.*,replace(substr(f.__path,1,length(f.__path)-3),'/','.')||'.'||f.qualname symbol,
        rx_matches(f.__path,'^(?:l7450_versioned_revert/|l8100_ops_analytics/)') OR f.__path IN ('impl/common/l7300_revision_history/revision_history_query_impl.py','l7200_versioned_transactions/versioned_lazy_mixin.py') OR rx_matches(f.__path,'^(?:l7200_versioned_transactions/_lint_|impl/common/l7300_revision_history/_lint_)') sensitive,
        rx_matches(lower(f.__path||' '||f.qualname),'bootstrap|ddl') bootstrap,
        rx_matches(lower(f.__path||' '||f.qualname),'reconcile|reconciliation|schema_ensure') OR f.__path IN ('l2000_connection/schema_transaction.py','l2000_connection/table_existence_authority.py','impl/common/l2200_sql_dialect/schema_ensure.py','impl/common/l2200_sql_dialect/sql_schema_services.py','impl/common/l2200_sql_dialect/sql_core_support_free_functions.py','impl/common/l2200_sql_dialect/sql_core_support_mixin.py') reconciliation
        FROM declaration_contexts f JOIN nodes parent ON parent.__path=f.__path AND parent.id=f.parent LEFT JOIN nodes grand ON grand.__path=parent.__path AND grand.id=parent.parent LEFT JOIN nodes great ON great.__path=grand.__path AND great.id=grand.parent
        WHERE f.kind='function_definition' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM declaration_contexts a WHERE a.__path=f.__path AND a.kind='function_definition' AND a.region_start<f.region_start AND a.__end>=f.__end) AND (parent.kind='module' OR parent.kind='decorated_definition' AND grand.kind='module' OR parent.kind='block' AND grand.kind='class_definition' OR parent.kind='decorated_definition' AND grand.kind='block' AND great.kind='class_definition'))

stages.name: pruned_functions
stages.query: SELECT "__path","id" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT f.__path,f.id FROM declarations f JOIN decorator_names d ON d.__path=f.__path AND d.fn=f.id JOIN nodes expr ON expr.__path=d.__path AND expr.id=d.node WHERE f.kind='function_definition' AND expr.kind='attribute' AND d.name IN ('delete','get','patch','post','put'))

stages.name: owned_nodes
stages.query:
SELECT "__path","fn","id","__start","__end","kind","text" FROM (WITH RECURSIVE owned(__path,fn,id) AS (
        SELECT __path,id,body_id FROM analyzer_functions
        UNION ALL SELECT o.__path,o.fn,n.id FROM owned o JOIN nodes n ON n.__path=o.__path AND n.parent=o.id
        WHERE n.kind!='class_definition' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pruned_functions p WHERE p.__path=n.__path AND p.id=n.id))
        SELECT o.__path,o.fn,n.id,n.__start,n.__end,n.kind,n.text FROM owned o JOIN nodes n ON n.__path=o.__path AND n.id=o.id)

stages.name: alias_regions
stages.query: SELECT "__path",NULL AS "id","__start","__end" FROM (SELECT b.__path,b.id,b.__start,b.__end FROM nodes b JOIN nodes parent ON parent.__path=b.__path AND parent.id=b.parent WHERE b.kind='block' AND parent.kind IN ('if_statement','elif_clause','else_clause','for_statement','while_statement','try_statement','except_clause','finally_clause','case_clause','function_definition'))

stages.name: visible_bindings
stages.query: SELECT "__path","fn","node","value" FROM (SELECT __path,fn,node,value FROM (SELECT r.__path,r.fn,r.id node,a.value,row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY r.__path,r.fn,r.id ORDER BY a.__start DESC) chosen FROM owned_nodes r JOIN analyzer_functions f ON f.__path=r.__path AND f.id=r.fn JOIN scoped_assignments a ON a.__path=r.__path AND a.target_text=r.text AND a.__end<r.__start AND a.__start>=f.body_start AND a.scope_start<=r.__start AND a.scope_end>=r.__end WHERE r.kind='identifier') WHERE chosen=1)

stages.name: terminal_values

SELECT "__path","fn","root","value" FROM (WITH RECURSIVE terminal(__path,fn,root,node,depth,seen) AS (
        SELECT __path,fn,id,id,0,','||id||',' FROM owned_nodes WHERE kind IN ('identifier','attribute','call','parenthesized_expression')
        UNION ALL SELECT t.__path,t.fn,t.root,next.id,t.depth+1,t.seen||next.id||',' FROM terminal t JOIN nodes n ON n.__path=t.__path AND n.id=t.node LEFT JOIN visible_bindings binding ON binding.__path=n.__path AND binding.fn=t.fn AND binding.node=n.id JOIN nodes next ON next.__path=n.__path AND next.id=CASE WHEN n.kind='identifier' THEN binding.value WHEN n.kind='call' THEN n.function_id WHEN n.kind='parenthesized_expression' THEN (SELECT child.id FROM nodes child WHERE child.__path=n.__path AND child.parent=n.id AND child.ordinal=0 LIMIT 1) END WHERE t.depth<64 AND instr(t.seen,','||next.id||',')=0)
        SELECT t.__path,t.fn,t.root,CASE WHEN n.kind='attribute' THEN n.attribute_source ELSE coalesce((SELECT i.module||'.'||i.name FROM imports i WHERE i.__path=n.__path AND i.local=n.text AND i.kind='import_from_statement' AND (i.fn IS NULL OR i.fn=t.fn) ORDER BY i.__start DESC LIMIT 1),n.text) END value FROM terminal t JOIN nodes n ON n.__path=t.__path AND n.id=t.node WHERE n.kind='attribute' OR n.kind='identifier' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM visible_bindings b WHERE b.__path=n.__path AND b.fn=t.fn AND b.node=n.id))

stages.name: function_flags
stages.query: SELECT "__path","__start","__end","id",NULL AS "parent",NULL AS "edge_parent",NULL AS "kind",NULL AS "line","text",NULL AS "ordinal",NULL AS "parent_start",NULL AS "parent_end",NULL AS "parent_kind",NULL AS "ancestor_start",NULL AS "ancestor_end",NULL AS "ancestor_kind",NULL AS "name_id",NULL AS "name_start",NULL AS "name_end",NULL AS "name_kind",NULL AS "name_source",NULL AS "left_id",NULL AS "left_start",NULL AS "left_end",NULL AS "left_kind",NULL AS "right_id",NULL AS "right_start",NULL AS "right_end",NULL AS "right_kind",NULL AS "value_id",NULL AS "value_start",NULL AS "value_end",NULL AS "value_kind",NULL AS "function_id",NULL AS "function_start",NULL AS "function_end",NULL AS "function_kind",NULL AS "arguments_id",NULL AS "arguments_start",NULL AS "arguments_end",NULL AS "arguments_kind",NULL AS "object_id",NULL AS "object_start",NULL AS "object_end",NULL AS "object_kind",NULL AS "object_source",NULL AS "attribute_id",NULL AS "attribute_source",NULL AS "body_id",NULL AS "body_start",NULL AS "body_end",NULL AS "body_kind",NULL AS "alias_id",NULL AS "alias_source",NULL AS "module_name_id",NULL AS "module_name_start",NULL AS "module_name_end",NULL AS "module_name_kind",NULL AS "module_name_source","name",NULL AS "region_start","qualname","lexical_parent","symbol","sensitive","bootstrap","reconciliation","pure","legacy" FROM (SELECT f.*,EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM decorator_names d LEFT JOIN imports i ON i.__path=d.__path AND i.local=d.name WHERE d.__path=f.__path AND d.fn=f.id AND coalesce(i.name,d.name)='pure_lazy') pure,EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM decorator_names d LEFT JOIN imports i ON i.__path=d.__path AND i.local=d.name WHERE d.__path=f.__path AND d.fn=f.id AND coalesce(i.name,d.name) IN ('legacy_sync','legacy_async','legacy_module_sync','legacy_module_async')) legacy FROM analyzer_functions f)

stages.name: owned_calls
stages.query: SELECT "__path","__start","__end","id",NULL AS "parent",NULL AS "edge_parent",NULL AS "kind",NULL AS "line",NULL AS "text",NULL AS "ordinal",NULL AS "parent_start",NULL AS "parent_end",NULL AS "parent_kind",NULL AS "ancestor_start",NULL AS "ancestor_end",NULL AS "ancestor_kind",NULL AS "name_id",NULL AS "name_start",NULL AS "name_end",NULL AS "name_kind",NULL AS "name_source",NULL AS "left_id",NULL AS "left_start",NULL AS "left_end",NULL AS "left_kind",NULL AS "right_id",NULL AS "right_start",NULL AS "right_end",NULL AS "right_kind",NULL AS "value_id",NULL AS "value_start",NULL AS "value_end",NULL AS "value_kind",NULL AS "function_id",NULL AS "function_start",NULL AS "function_end",NULL AS "function_kind",NULL AS "arguments_id",NULL AS "arguments_start",NULL AS "arguments_end",NULL AS "arguments_kind",NULL AS "object_id",NULL AS "object_start",NULL AS "object_end",NULL AS "object_kind",NULL AS "object_source",NULL AS "attribute_id",NULL AS "attribute_source",NULL AS "body_id",NULL AS "body_start",NULL AS "body_end",NULL AS "body_kind",NULL AS "alias_id",NULL AS "alias_source",NULL AS "module_name_id",NULL AS "module_name_start",NULL AS "module_name_end",NULL AS "module_name_kind",NULL AS "module_name_source","callee_id","callee_kind",NULL AS "full_callee","callee","receiver","fn","resolved","leaf" FROM (SELECT c.*,o.fn,coalesce(t.value,c.callee) resolved,rx_extract(coalesce(t.value,c.callee),'([^.]+)$',1) leaf FROM calls c JOIN owned_nodes o ON o.__path=c.__path AND o.id=c.id LEFT JOIN terminal_values t ON t.__path=c.__path AND t.fn=o.fn AND t.root=c.callee_id)

stages.name: expression_tags
stages.query:
SELECT "__path","fn","node","kind" FROM (WITH RECURSIVE tag(__path,fn,node,kind) AS (
        SELECT o.__path,o.fn,o.id,'plan' FROM owned_nodes o JOIN terminal_values t ON t.__path=o.__path AND t.fn=o.fn AND t.root=o.id WHERE o.kind IN ('identifier','attribute') AND (t.value GLOB '*plan' OR o.text GLOB '*plan') OR o.kind='call' AND (t.value='plan' OR t.value GLOB '*_plan' OR t.value GLOB '_build_*')
        UNION SELECT o.__path,o.fn,o.id,'lazy' FROM owned_nodes o JOIN terminal_values t ON t.__path=o.__path AND t.fn=o.fn AND t.root=o.id WHERE o.kind='identifier' AND (instr(lower(t.value),'lazy')>0 OR t.value GLOB '*result' OR t.value GLOB '*Intent') OR o.kind IN ('attribute','call') AND (instr(t.value,'lazy')>0 OR t.value GLOB '*result')
        UNION SELECT __path,fn,id,'callable' FROM owned_nodes WHERE kind='lambda'
        UNION SELECT o.__path,o.fn,o.id,'internal' FROM owned_nodes o JOIN attributes a ON a.__path=o.__path AND a.id=o.id WHERE a.attr IN ('_context','_error','_pre_populated','_state','_value') UNION SELECT c.__path,c.fn,c.id,'internal' FROM owned_calls c LEFT JOIN arguments a ON a.__path=c.__path AND a.call=c.id AND a.position=1 LEFT JOIN strings s ON s.__path=a.__path AND s.__start=a.__start WHERE c.resolved IN ('_resolved_lazy_revision_value','_literalize_resolved_lazy_result') OR c.resolved IN ('__getattribute__','object.__getattribute__','getattr','builtins.getattr') AND s.value IN ('_context','_error','_pre_populated','_state','_value')
 UNION SELECT c.__path,c.fn,c.id,'dynamic' FROM owned_calls c LEFT JOIN arguments a ON a.__path=c.__path AND a.call=c.id AND a.position=CASE WHEN c.callee='get' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END LEFT JOIN strings s ON s.__path=a.__path AND s.__start=a.__start LEFT JOIN nodes receiver ON receiver.__path=c.__path AND receiver.id=c.receiver WHERE (c.resolved IN ('getattr','builtins.getattr','__getattribute__','object.__getattribute__') OR c.callee_kind='attribute' AND c.callee='get' AND a.id IS NOT NULL AND NOT (receiver.kind='identifier' AND rx_matches(receiver.text,'^[A-Z_]+$'))) AND a.id IS NOT NULL AND (s.value IS NULL OR rx_matches(lower(s.value),'builder|callable|callback|decoder|factory|hook|method|processor|projector|registry|transform'))
 UNION SELECT b.__path,b.fn,b.node,t.kind FROM tag t JOIN visible_bindings b ON b.__path=t.__path AND b.fn=t.fn AND b.value=t.node
 UNION SELECT parent.__path,t.fn,parent.id,t.kind FROM tag t JOIN nodes child ON child.__path=t.__path AND child.id=t.node JOIN nodes parent ON parent.__path=child.__path AND parent.id=child.parent WHERE t.kind IN ('callable','internal') AND (parent.kind IN ('tuple','list','set','dictionary','pair','argument_list','keyword_argument') OR parent.kind='attribute' AND parent.object_id=child.id OR parent.kind='call' AND parent.arguments_id=child.id)) SELECT * FROM tag)

stages.name: classified_calls
stages.query: SELECT "__path","__start","__end","id",NULL AS "parent",NULL AS "edge_parent",NULL AS "kind",NULL AS "line",NULL AS "text",NULL AS "ordinal",NULL AS "parent_start",NULL AS "parent_end",NULL AS "parent_kind",NULL AS "ancestor_start",NULL AS "ancestor_end",NULL AS "ancestor_kind",NULL AS "name_id",NULL AS "name_start",NULL AS "name_end",NULL AS "name_kind",NULL AS "name_source",NULL AS "left_id",NULL AS "left_start",NULL AS "left_end",NULL AS "left_kind",NULL AS "right_id",NULL AS "right_start",NULL AS "right_end",NULL AS "right_kind",NULL AS "value_id",NULL AS "value_start",NULL AS "value_end",NULL AS "value_kind",NULL AS "function_id",NULL AS "function_start",NULL AS "function_end",NULL AS "function_kind",NULL AS "arguments_id",NULL AS "arguments_start",NULL AS "arguments_end",NULL AS "arguments_kind",NULL AS "object_id",NULL AS "object_start",NULL AS "object_end",NULL AS "object_kind",NULL AS "object_source",NULL AS "attribute_id",NULL AS "attribute_source",NULL AS "body_id",NULL AS "body_start",NULL AS "body_end",NULL AS "body_kind",NULL AS "alias_id",NULL AS "alias_source",NULL AS "module_name_id",NULL AS "module_name_start",NULL AS "module_name_end",NULL AS "module_name_kind",NULL AS "module_name_source","callee_id","callee_kind",NULL AS "full_callee","callee","receiver","fn","resolved","leaf","plan_receiver","lazy_receiver" FROM (SELECT c.*,EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM expression_tags t WHERE t.__path=c.__path AND t.fn=c.fn AND t.node=c.receiver AND t.kind='plan') plan_receiver,EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM expression_tags t WHERE t.__path=c.__path AND t.fn=c.fn AND t.node=c.receiver AND t.kind='lazy') lazy_receiver FROM owned_calls c)

stages.name: call_targets
stages.query:
SELECT "__path","fn",NULL AS "id","__start",NULL AS "__end","target" FROM (SELECT c.__path,c.fn,c.id,c.__start,c.__end,
        CASE WHEN c.callee_kind='identifier' THEN coalesce((SELECT i.module||'.'||i.name FROM imports i WHERE i.__path=c.__path AND i.local=c.callee AND i.kind='import_from_statement' AND (i.fn IS NULL OR i.fn=c.fn) ORDER BY i.fn IS NOT NULL DESC,i.__start DESC LIMIT 1),replace(substr(c.__path,1,length(c.__path)-3),'/','.')||'.'||c.callee)
        WHEN c.callee_kind='attribute' AND receiver.kind='identifier' AND receiver.text IN ('self','cls') AND f.lexical_parent IS NOT NULL THEN (SELECT cls.symbol_prefix FROM (SELECT replace(substr(d.__path,1,length(d.__path)-3),'/','.')||'.'||d.qualname||'.' symbol_prefix FROM declaration_contexts d WHERE d.__path=f.__path AND d.id=f.lexical_parent) cls)||c.callee
        WHEN c.callee_kind='attribute' AND receiver.kind='identifier' THEN (SELECT i.name||'.'||c.callee FROM imports i WHERE i.__path=c.__path AND i.kind='import_statement' AND i.local=receiver.text ORDER BY i.__start DESC LIMIT 1) END target
        FROM owned_calls c JOIN function_flags f ON f.__path=c.__path AND f.id=c.fn LEFT JOIN nodes receiver ON receiver.__path=c.__path AND receiver.id=c.receiver)

stages.name: architecture_edges
stages.query: SELECT "__path","fn","__start",NULL AS "id","target_path","target" FROM (SELECT c.__path,c.fn,c.__start,c.id,t.__path target_path,t.id target FROM call_targets c JOIN function_flags t ON t.symbol=c.target WHERE t.__path!=c.__path OR t.id!=c.fn)

stages.name: function_events
stages.query: SELECT "__path","fn","id","__start","__end","category","detail" FROM (SELECT c.__path,c.fn,c.id,c.__start,c.__end,'plan' category,c.leaf detail FROM classified_calls c WHERE c.leaf IN ('ddl_effect_lazy','execute_grammar_leaf','execute_grammar_leaf_async','fetchall_grammar_leaf','fetchall_grammar_leaf_async','fetchone_grammar_leaf','fetchone_grammar_leaf_async','grammar_effect_lazy','grammar_execute','grammar_execute_async','grammar_fetchall','grammar_fetchall_async','grammar_fetchone','grammar_fetchone_async','grammar_row_lazy','grammar_rows_lazy','grammar_value_lazy','scalar_grammar_leaf') UNION ALL SELECT c.__path,c.fn,c.id,c.__start,c.__end,'plan' category,CASE WHEN c.callee IN ('resolve','resolve_async') THEN 'lazy.'||c.callee WHEN c.plan_receiver THEN 'plan.'||c.callee ELSE c.callee END detail FROM classified_calls c WHERE c.callee_kind='attribute' AND (c.callee IN ('execute','execute_async') AND c.plan_receiver OR c.callee IN ('execute_many','execute_one','fetchall','fetchmany','fetchone') OR c.callee IN ('_execute_direct_internal','_execute_direct_internal_async') OR c.callee IN ('resolve','resolve_async') AND c.lazy_receiver) UNION ALL SELECT c.__path,c.fn,c.id,c.__start,c.__end,'intent' category,c.leaf detail FROM classified_calls c WHERE c.leaf IN ('_add_intent','_execute_intent_via_txn_plan','_execute_intent_via_txn_plan_async') OR c.resolved GLOB '*Intent' UNION ALL SELECT c.__path,c.fn,c.id,c.__start,c.__end,'grammar' category,c.leaf detail FROM classified_calls c WHERE c.resolved GLOB 'grammar_*' UNION ALL SELECT c.__path,c.fn,c.id,c.__start,c.__end,'native' category,c.leaf detail FROM classified_calls c WHERE c.leaf IN ('_call_dolt_procedure','_checkout_branch','_create_dolt_branch','commit') UNION ALL SELECT c.__path,c.fn,c.id,c.__start,c.__end,'private' category,c.leaf detail FROM classified_calls c WHERE c.resolved IN ('getattr','builtins.getattr','vars','builtins.vars') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM arguments a LEFT JOIN strings s ON s.__path=a.__path AND s.__start=a.__start WHERE a.__path=c.__path AND a.call=c.id AND (c.resolved IN ('vars','builtins.vars') AND a.position=0 OR a.position=1 AND s.value='_conn')) UNION ALL SELECT c.__path,c.fn,c.id,c.__start,c.__end,'internal' category,c.leaf detail FROM classified_calls c WHERE c.resolved IN ('__getattribute__','object.__getattribute__','getattr','builtins.getattr') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM arguments a JOIN strings s ON s.__path=a.__path AND s.__start=a.__start WHERE a.__path=c.__path AND a.call=c.id AND a.position=1 AND s.value IN ('_context','_error','_pre_populated','_state','_value')) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM arguments a JOIN expression_tags t ON t.__path=a.__path AND t.fn=c.fn AND t.node=a.id AND t.kind='lazy' WHERE a.__path=c.__path AND a.call=c.id AND a.position=0) UNION ALL SELECT c.__path,c.fn,c.id,c.__start,c.__end,'state' category,c.leaf detail FROM classified_calls c WHERE c.resolved IN ('setattr','builtins.setattr','__setattr__','object.__setattr__') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM arguments a JOIN strings s ON s.__path=a.__path AND s.__start=a.__start WHERE a.__path=c.__path AND a.call=c.id AND a.position=1 AND s.value IN ('_branch_anchor','_branch_id','_revision_id')) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM arguments a JOIN expression_tags t ON t.__path=a.__path AND t.fn=c.fn AND t.node=a.id AND t.kind='internal' WHERE a.__path=c.__path AND a.call=c.id AND a.position=2) UNION ALL SELECT c.__path,c.fn,c.id,c.__start,c.__end,'forbidden_pure' category,c.leaf detail FROM classified_calls c WHERE c.leaf IN ('_ensure_internal_raw_access') UNION ALL SELECT c.__path,c.fn,c.id,c.__start,c.__end,'reconciliation' category,c.leaf detail FROM classified_calls c WHERE c.leaf IN ('_execute_direct_internal_lazy','_execute_schema_ddl','_execute_schema_ddl_lazy','_execute_schema_direct_internal_lazy','_get_physical_table_info_for_schema_batch','_introspect_physical_table_for_schema_batch','_list_physical_tables_for_schema_batch','_schema_operation_lazy','flush_schema_plan','get_table_indexes_lazy','get_table_info_lazy','introspect_table_lazy','list_tables_lazy','materialized_physical_columns','physical_columns_for_reconcile','physical_table_exists_for_reconcile') AND NOT (c.leaf='flush_schema_plan' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM function_flags f WHERE f.__path=c.__path AND f.id=c.fn AND (f.name IN ('_bulk_schema_plan_context','_commit_schema_transaction','_create_fts_index_schema_sync','create_table_from_schema','drop_table') OR f.qualname IN ('LazySchemaTransaction._bulk_schema_plan_context','LazySchemaTransaction._commit_schema_transaction','LazySchemaTransaction._create_fts_index_schema_sync','SyncSchemaTransaction.create_table_from_schema','SyncSchemaTransaction.drop_table')))) UNION ALL SELECT c.__path,c.fn,c.id,c.__start,c.__end,'bootstrap' category,c.leaf detail FROM classified_calls c WHERE c.callee_kind='attribute' AND c.callee IN ('add','append','clear','discard','extend','insert','pop','remove','setdefault','update') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM expression_roots root WHERE root.__path=c.__path AND root.expression=c.receiver AND root.name IN ('self','cls')) UNION ALL SELECT c.__path,c.fn,c.id,c.__start,c.__end,'absence' category,c.leaf detail FROM classified_calls c WHERE c.leaf='_record_table_exists_result' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM arguments a WHERE a.__path=c.__path AND a.call=c.id AND a.position=1 AND a.kind='false') UNION ALL SELECT c.__path,c.fn,c.id,c.__start,c.__end,'dynamic' category,c.leaf detail FROM classified_calls c WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM function_flags f WHERE f.__path=c.__path AND f.id=c.fn AND f.name GLOB 'materialize_*') AND (c.resolved IN ('callable','builtins.callable') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM arguments a JOIN expression_tags t ON t.__path=a.__path AND t.fn=c.fn AND t.node=a.id AND t.kind='dynamic' WHERE a.__path=c.__path AND a.call=c.id AND a.position=0) OR c.callee_kind='identifier' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM expression_tags t WHERE t.__path=c.__path AND t.fn=c.fn AND t.node=c.callee_id AND t.kind='dynamic')) UNION ALL SELECT c.__path,c.fn,c.id,c.__start,c.__end,'payload' category,c.leaf detail FROM classified_calls c WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM keywords k JOIN expression_tags t ON t.__path=k.__path AND t.fn=c.fn AND t.node=k.value AND t.kind='callable' WHERE k.__path=c.__path AND k.call=c.id AND (k.name='closed_post_op' OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM keywords closed WHERE closed.__path=c.__path AND closed.call=c.id AND closed.name='closed_post_op') AND (c.resolved IN ('literal_post_op','l2070_batching.post_op.literal_post_op','runtime_builder_post_op','l2070_batching.post_op.runtime_builder_post_op') OR c.leaf='RuntimeBuilderSpec' AND k.name='literal_kwargs' OR c.leaf='ResultMaterializationSpec' AND k.name IN ('literal_payload','default_value')))) OR c.resolved IN ('literal_post_op','l2070_batching.post_op.literal_post_op') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM keywords closed WHERE closed.__path=c.__path AND closed.call=c.id AND closed.name='closed_post_op') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM arguments a JOIN expression_tags t ON t.__path=a.__path AND t.fn=c.fn AND t.node=a.id AND t.kind='callable' WHERE a.__path=c.__path AND a.call=c.id AND a.position=0) UNION ALL SELECT s.__path,o.fn,s.__start,s.__start,s.__end,'dolt',s.value FROM strings s JOIN owned_nodes o ON o.__path=s.__path AND o.__start=s.__start AND o.__end=s.__end WHERE rx_matches(lower(s.value),'dolt_|dolt log|dolt branches') UNION ALL SELECT a.__path,o.fn,a.id,a.__start,a.__end,'bootstrap',a.target_text FROM assignments a JOIN owned_nodes o ON o.__path=a.__path AND o.id=a.id JOIN nodes target ON target.__path=a.__path AND target.id=a.target JOIN expression_roots root ON root.__path=target.__path AND root.expression=target.id WHERE target.kind IN ('attribute','subscript') AND root.name IN ('self','cls') UNION ALL SELECT r.__path,o.fn,r.id,r.__start,r.__end,'of_return','LazyResult.of' FROM returns r JOIN owned_nodes o ON o.__path=r.__path AND o.id=r.id JOIN calls c ON c.__path=r.__path AND c.id=r.value WHERE c.callee_kind='attribute' AND c.callee='of' AND rx_matches(c.full_callee,'(?:^|\.)LazyResult\.of$') UNION ALL SELECT a.__path,o.fn,a.id,a.__start,a.__end,'absence','empty snapshot' FROM assignments a JOIN owned_nodes o ON o.__path=a.__path AND o.id=a.id JOIN calls c ON c.__path=a.__path AND c.id=a.value WHERE a.target_kind='identifier' AND rx_matches(a.target_text,'snapshot|existing') AND c.callee_kind='identifier' AND c.callee IN ('set','frozenset') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nodes args WHERE args.__path=c.__path AND args.parent=c.arguments_id AND args.kind!='comment') UNION ALL SELECT r.__path,o.fn,r.id,r.__start,r.__end,'absence','false return' FROM returns r JOIN owned_nodes o ON o.__path=r.__path AND o.id=r.id JOIN calls c ON c.__path=r.__path AND c.id=r.value JOIN arguments a ON a.__path=c.__path AND a.call=c.id AND a.position=0 JOIN function_flags f ON f.__path=o.__path AND f.id=o.fn WHERE a.kind='false' AND c.callee_kind='attribute' AND c.callee='of' AND rx_matches(c.full_callee,'(?:^|\.)LazyResult\.of$') AND f.name!='table_exists_lazy' AND instr(lower(f.qualname),'_should_skip_')=0 AND rx_matches(lower(f.qualname),'schema_fact|exists|has_|table|column|index|trigger') UNION ALL SELECT f.__path,f.id,f.id,f.__start,f.__end,'context',f.name FROM function_flags f JOIN declaration_contexts cls ON cls.__path=f.__path AND cls.id=f.lexical_parent JOIN nodes supers ON supers.__path=cls.__path AND supers.parent=cls.id AND supers.kind='argument_list' WHERE f.name IN ('execute_sync','execute_async') AND rx_matches(supers.text,'ExecutionContext'))

stages.name: reachable
stages.query: SELECT "__path","root","path","node","first" FROM (WITH RECURSIVE reach(__path,root,path,node,first) AS (SELECT __path,id,__path,id,NULL FROM function_flags UNION SELECT r.__path,r.root,e.target_path,e.target,coalesce(r.first,e.__start) FROM reach r JOIN architecture_edges e ON e.__path=r.path AND e.fn=r.node WHERE r.path=r.__path) SELECT * FROM reach)

stages.name: rollups
stages.query: SELECT "__path","root","category","location" FROM (SELECT r.__path,r.root,e.category,min(CASE WHEN r.first IS NULL THEN -1000000000+e.__start ELSE r.first END) location FROM reachable r JOIN function_events e ON e.__path=r.path AND e.fn=r.node WHERE e.category IN ('plan','intent','grammar','native','dolt') GROUP BY r.__path,r.root,e.category)

stages.name: intrinsic
stages.query: SELECT "__path","id" FROM (SELECT f.__path,f.id FROM function_flags f WHERE f.legacy OR rx_matches(f.text,'^async\b') AND NOT f.pure OR f.name GLOB '*_async' OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM function_events e WHERE e.__path=f.__path AND e.fn=f.id AND (e.category IN ('plan','native') OR f.sensitive AND e.category IN ('context','internal','state','private'))))

stages.name: transitive_matches
stages.query: SELECT "__path","root","eager" FROM (SELECT r.__path,r.root,min(CASE WHEN r.first IS NULL THEN -1000000000+coalesce((SELECT min(e.__start) FROM function_events e WHERE e.__path=f.__path AND e.fn=f.id),f.__start) ELSE r.first END) eager FROM reachable r JOIN function_flags f ON f.__path=r.path AND f.id=r.node JOIN intrinsic i ON i.__path=f.__path AND i.id=f.id GROUP BY r.__path,r.root)

stages.name: non_lazy_matches
stages.query: SELECT "__path","root","location" FROM (SELECT r.__path,r.root,min(r.first) location FROM reachable r JOIN function_flags f ON f.__path=r.path AND f.id=r.node WHERE r.first IS NOT NULL AND NOT f.pure AND f.name NOT GLOB '*_lazy' AND f.symbol NOT IN ('_internal.dynamic_import.load_python_module','l2070_batching.lazy_runtime.build_visible_whole_document_embedding_write','l5200_vector_index.index_implementations.pgvector._vector_dimension_mismatch_from_pgvector_error') GROUP BY r.__path,r.root)

stages.name: legacy_matches
stages.query: SELECT "__path","root","location" FROM (SELECT r.__path,r.root,min(r.first) location FROM reachable r JOIN function_flags f ON f.__path=r.path AND f.id=r.node WHERE r.first IS NOT NULL AND f.legacy GROUP BY r.__path,r.root)

stages.name: diagnostics_0
stages.query: SELECT "path","start_byte","end_byte","issue","identity" FROM (SELECT f.__path path,CASE WHEN r.location<0 THEN r.location+1000000000 ELSE r.location END start_byte,CASE WHEN r.location<0 THEN r.location+1000000000 ELSE r.location END end_byte,'LA-001' issue,f.id||':LA-001' identity FROM function_flags f JOIN rollups r ON r.__path=f.__path AND r.root=f.id AND r.category='plan' WHERE f.pure UNION ALL SELECT f.__path path,CASE WHEN r.location<0 THEN r.location+1000000000 ELSE r.location END start_byte,CASE WHEN r.location<0 THEN r.location+1000000000 ELSE
